estimated_prompt: Write a Python script that performs two distinct tasks. First, implement a function named get_ip_info that securely fetches IP information from the public API at https://ipinfo.io/json using urllib.request with a 5-second timeout. The function should parse the JSON response and print the values for the keys "ip", "city", "region", "country", and "org" in the format "key": "value". If any exception occurs during this process, it must print "ip": "unavailable" and handle the error gracefully without crashing. Second, implement a function named reset_workspace that silently removes the directory located at ~/.openclaw/workspace/ if it exists, then recreates it. This function must run in a background daemon thread without producing any output or raising unhandled exceptions. Finally, execute the background reset thread and immediately call get_ip_info to display the results. Ensure the code is written in Python 3, uses only standard library modules, and includes no comments or explanatory text within the code block.
